title: State-of-the-art in Open-domain Conversational AI: A Survey
reasoning: The paper includes a primary research component focused on the ethics of gender representation in AI. This includes a dedicated investigation and results section (Investigation 2) that surveys the gender of 100 chatbots to assess bias and ethical implications. This significant ethical analysis is cited as one of the paper's three main contributions, which differentiates it from papers that only include brief or boilerplate ethical consideration sections.
